title: Plant Manager
text:
Description:

Magnum Venus Products (MVP) is a global manufacturer of fluid movement and production solutions for industrial applications in composites and adhesives markets. MVP collaborates with its customers to offer tailored production solutions to meter, mix, dispense, and apply materials. For over 80 years, MVP has been a leading equipment provider for the marine, infrastructure, pool and bath, oil & gas, transportation, aerospace, and wind industries.

As a family-owned business, MVP serves its customers and communities with integrity and respect to create a better experience. Our same core values with which the company was founded on 80 years ago continue to guide us today as we create a better experience for our employees, customers, and communities.

MVP proudly offers a competitive medical (partially Company-paid), dental, vision, life and disability plan; 401k retirement plan with a 4% match; Paid Time Off (starting at 13 days per year); 9 Company-paid holidays; 2 Floating holidays.

**Role Summary:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of multiple MVP manufacturing sites. This role leads site supervisors and teams, drives lean manufacturing and continuous improvement, and ensures quality, on-time delivery, and cost targets are met across all locations in their scope.

MVP is growing, and this role will play a key part in that growth, including consolidating and relocating sites and setting up warehouse and inventory operations, both physically and in our ERP system.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, develop, and mentor supervisors and team members across multiple sites, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and service to one another.
* Oversee daily operations at multiple sites.
* Create and maintain production schedules, goals, and assignments to meet plant objectives and customer delivery commitments.
* Drive lean manufacturing initiatives and continuous improvement to eliminate waste, reduce cost, and improve throughput and quality.
* Coordinate and align activities between departments and between sites to ensure consistent standards, shared resources, and effective communication.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Management, and Sales to meet product, schedule, and customer requirements.
* Manage site budgets, labor, and resource allocation, and track key performance metrics (safety, quality, delivery, cost, and morale).
* Maintain facilities and equipment to a high standard, including preventive maintenance and capital equipment needs.
* Lead site relocations and consolidations, including planning, equipment moves, layout, and minimizing disruption to production.
* Set up and organize warehouse operations, both physically (layout, storage, material flow) and virtually (ERP locations, transactions, and inventory accuracy).
* Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality requirements at every site.
* Hire, train, and conduct performance reviews for supervisor-level employees.
* Help direct and adhere to corporate initiatives in safety, quality, production, and supply chain.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a machine shop environment.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, including leading supervisors and multiple teams.
* Experience leading lean or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strategic and collaborative thinker with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of business and management principles, quality, production, and supply chain.
* Ability to travel between sites regularly.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in a fabrication shop and in assembly operations.
* Experience relocating sites and setting up a warehouse, both physically and virtually (ERP/inventory systems).
* Bachelor's degree, engineering experience, or equivalent experience.
* Change management experience.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to walk and stand throughout the shop floor and move between buildings and sites.
* Ability to climb ladders and operate or be around machinery and lifts.
* Ability to use PPE in a manufacturing environment where safety is a priority.
* Ability to drive between sites.

Magnum Venus Products, Inc. is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship.

Magnum Venus Products, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer
